image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming over a textured, light-colored rocky or coral substrate. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and bright yellow posterior body/tail. The eye is visible but appears somewhat stylized or obscured by the angle/resolution. The mouth area is blurry.

The caudal fin appears rounded, consistent with the species description, though edges are soft.

The connection between the dorsal fin and the body lacks clear definition; the fin seems to melt slightly into the black body patch without distinct attachment points.
